major_issues.issue: 草稿在'实验设计及结果分析'(五)(五)段落中称'全部 5 株革兰阴性菌 (E. coli CCARM 1009、S. typhimurium CCARM 8250、A. baumannii ATCC 19606、K. pneumoniae ATCC 13883、P. aeruginosa 15690) 上 1–3 MIC 均 >25 µg/mL'。但 Table 2 显示化合物 1 对 K. pneumoniae ATCC 13883 与 P. aeruginosa 15690 的 MIC 均为 25 µg/mL（而非 >25），化合物 2、3 在这两株上才是 >25。草稿把 1 的两个 '25' 误并入 >25 集合。

verified_claims.claim: 新化合物 1 (nobilamide Q3) 鉴定为 N-Ac-L-Phe-D-Leu-L-Phe-D-Thr-L-Val-L-Ala-Dhb；化合物 2 (nobilamide R3) 为 N-Ac-L-Phe-D-Leu-D-Phe-D-Thr-L-Val-L-Ala-Dhb；化合物 3 为 N-Ac-D-Phe-D-Leu-L-Phe-D-Thr-L-Val-L-Ala-Dhb (A-3302-B)
verified_claims.evidence: 原文：'compound 1 was identified as a new stereoisomer of the known compound A-3302-B (3), N-Ac-L-Phe-D-Leu-L-Phe-D-Thr-L-Val-L-Ala-Dhb, and named nobilamide Q3… compound 2 was established as a new stereoisomer of A-3302-B (3), N-Ac-L-Phe-D-Leu-D-Phe-D-Thr-L-Val-L-Ala-Dhb, and designated as nobilamide R3.'

verified_claims.claim: 化合物 2 (R3) 与 3 (A-3302-B) 对 S. aureus CCARM 3090 的 MIC 分别为 3.25 与 6.25 µg/mL，化合物 1 (Q3) 为 25 µg/mL；阳性对照四环素 MIC = 6.25 µg/mL
verified_claims.evidence: 原文：'nobilamide R3 (2) and A-3302-B (3) exhibited potent antibacterial activity against the Gram-positive MDR strain S. aureus CCARM 3090, with MIC values of 3.25 and 6.25 µg/mL, respectively… compound Q3 (1) showed only moderate activity against this strain (MIC = 25 µg/mL).' Table 2 第一行 Tet 列 = 6.25。

verified_claims.claim: HRESIMS [M+H]+ m/z 804.4277（计算值 804.4273 for C42H57O9N7），对应 18 个不饱和度
verified_claims.evidence: 原文：'a protonated molecule [M + H]+ at m/z 804.4277, indicating the molecular formula of C42H57O9N7, which required 18 degrees of unsaturation… HRESIMS m/z 804.4277 [M + H]+ (calcd for C42H57O9N7 804.4273).'

verified_claims.claim: 16S rRNA 与 B. subtilis NCIB 3610^T 的一致性为 99.93%；nblBS 与 B. halotolerans BCP32 nob 簇 NRPS 一致性 98–99%，与 paenibacterin / pelgipeptin 仅 35–50%
verified_claims.evidence: 原文：'99.93% identity to that of B. subtilis NCIB 3610T… NblABS and NblBBS, share 98–99% sequence identity with those from the recently characterized nobilamide (nbl) BGC in B. halotolerans BCP32… lower identity of 35–50% to the NRPS enzymes from the paenibacterin… and pelgipeptin BGCs.'

verified_claims.claim: Marfey 法确定 1 含 L-Ala / L-Val / D-Thr / L-Phe / D-Leu（两个 Phe 均为 L 构型），2 和 3 同时含 L-Phe 与 D-Phe
verified_claims.evidence: 原文：'HPLC analysis of the reaction mixtures led to the identification of L-Ala, L-Val, D-Thr, L-Phe and D-Leu (Figure S29), indicating that both phenylalanine residues are L-configured… HPLC analysis of the reaction mixtures and standard derivatives revealed the presence of both L-Phe and D-Phe in 2 and 3, in contrast to compound 1, which contains only L-Phe.'

verified_claims.claim: Phe^3 α-H 化学位移差异：化合物 1 (L-Phe^3) δH 4.66，化合物 2 (D-Phe^3) δH 4.40
verified_claims.source_locator: Table 1 (PDF p.5)；正文 Section 2.2 末段 (PDF p.6)
verified_claims.evidence: 原文：'the α-proton (H-2) of the D-Phe3 residue in nobilamide R3 (2) at δH 4.40 ppm is significantly shifted upfield compared to the L-Phe3 in nobilamide Q3 (1) at δH 4.66 ppm.' Table 1 中 1-Phe(H-2) = 4.66, 2-Phe(H-2) = 4.40。

verified_claims.claim: NRPS 模块底物预测顺序为 Phe^1 / Leu^2 / Phe^3 / Thr^4 / Val^5 / Ala^6 / Thr^7；末端 Thr^7 经脱水形成 Dhb^7，与 Thr^4 侧链羟基形成酯键大环

verified_claims.evidence: 原文：'Substrate specificities of the A-domains in NblABS and NblBBS were predicted using NRPSpredictor2 [20], suggesting their preferences for Phe1, Leu2, Phe3, Thr4, Val5, Ala6 and Thr7… The Thr7 residue is then proposed to undergo dehydration to generate the Dhb7 residue… macrocyclization via ester bond formation between Dhb7 and Thr4.'
